title: eat shit & die 189
author: bpatrick
body: Trying to keep up the pace. I have to go out of town tomorrow but hopefully this weekend will be filled with comic-making.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text:
I also refuse to live in burly guy world.

Thanks for all the comics, enjoy your weekend!

– bob

comments.author: David
comments.text: I am so happy about this new pace. Also that you addressed the least answerable question I’ve ever come across.

comments.author: Brotoflatron
comments.text: I said the exact same thing. The judge wasn’t very impressed by it, though. Damn Burly fascists.

comments.author: Phil C.
comments.text:
I went “Who the fuck is Burly Guy?” and then remembered the tag. THEN it was pretty clear. Forgot for a second that everything that happens in this comic tends to link remarkably well with other things in the comic. Even for the series that don’t tie together with others, the underlying message tends to be very familiar. 🙂

cheers,
Phil

comments.author: invertedquestionmark
comments.text: Awwww, a funny comic for a change. 😀 Loved it but I hopeyou’re not trying to force yourself to be funny as all your stuff is great.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: Three comics in one week! Keep up the good work, but don’t burn yourself out!

comments.author: kittencontinues
comments.text: I like how you placed the conversation in the primate part of the zoo as your setting. Great setting and excellent choice of colors. The second to last panel’s composition is awesome.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text:
Thanks, guys! I think I effed up the ending on this one. Better next time.
@D: I don’t want to outright disagree with you but I will say I make an effort to have at least some fleshed out, more complex characters. Whether or not I succeed…

comments.text: This comic is so, so true. It’s annoying how forceful society has become about things like ‘tolerance.’
